annotation.title_clean: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.title_en: UAE's International Stance on Artificial Intelligence Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UAE Government (Ministry of Cabinet Affairs / UAE Legislation portal)
annotation.summary_en: UAE public policy document (Sept 2024) setting out the country's international stance on AI: active participation in multilateral AI governance, standards-setting and alliances, transparency and accountability checkpoints, international rules against harmful AI, and six guiding principles beginning with advancement and collaboration to position the UAE as a global AI hub.
key_provisions_or_claims: UAE actively engages in international forums shaping AI standards and guidelines
Emphasises transparency and checkpoints in AI tools to ensure ethical compliance and accountability
Supports international alliances and rules holding nations accountable for AI intended to harm or destabilise
Six guiding principles including Advancement and Collaboration
Funding for AI research centres, startups, compute and adoption in healthcare, finance, transport, agriculture
